title: Fixed-size restriction probability is at most one
statement: Let $E$ be any event, that is, a property of restrictions on $n$ variables, and let $k$ be a natural number. Under the fixed-size restriction model $R_k$ — the uniform distribution over those restrictions on $n$ variables whose set of free variables has cardinality exactly $k$ — the probability of $E$ satisfies $R_k(E) \le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: E is an event (property of restrictions on n variables)
replaced:
For any event, the fixed-size restriction probability satisfies
$\mathrm{fixedSizeRestrProb}\,(\mathrm{event})\,k \le 1$.
